# KROCK.IO

> KROCK.IO is a collaborative video review and project management platform designed for creative teams working in video production, animation, and architectural visualization.

Founded by Alex Tahanchin, KROCK.IO provides tools for video proofing, animatics, storyboarding, and team collaboration across creative workflows. The platform integrates with industry-standard tools like Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro to streamline feedback and approval processes for video production teams.
